title: OP Hoe
description: A plugin that adds an Op Hoe diamond with inspiration from "This Hoe Does More Damage Then The Spear" by Staffmas on YouTube
body: A Plugin that adds a **_God Hoe_** resipe with Sharpness 7 Looting 3 Sweeping Edge 3 Efficiency 5 Unbreaking 3 and Mending also when held it gives you speed 2 fire res night vison and strength 2 (**_warning do not make the hoe netherite_**).
